r. 9th and 5th cls. (स्कुनाति-स्कुनीते स्कुनोति-स्कुनुते)
1 To go by leaps.
2 To cover.
3 To raise or lift.

(इ) स्कुदि r. 1st cl. (स्कुन्दते)
1 To jump, to go by leaps or jumps.
2 To raise, to lift up.

(उ) स्कुम्भु r. 5th and 9th cls. (स्कुभ्नोति-स्कुभ्नाति)
1 To stop or hinder.
2 To be dull or insensible.
